biotools.summary: CardioAtlas is a resource providing a comprehensive analysis of single-cell transcriptome data in cardiovascular tissues and diseases. It offers analytical modules for cell-type prediction, marker gene identification, and cell-cell communication analysis, alongside the ability for users to upload their own data for personalized analysis.
